content.description: Shiba Inu is the flagship meme token on Ethereum. ADA Shiba Inu, or A SHIB for short, is the 2.0 version of Shiba Inu built on Cardano, utilizing low gas fees and Cardano’s Extended UTXO model. The Cardano Sister to Ethereum’s Shiba Inu. ASHIB IS THE WOLF OF CARDANO. Born from the deep freeze of the crypto winter, ASHIB is not a pet—it is an Autonomous Contractor deployed on the Cardano blockchain. While others rely on hype, we rely on hard utility: verify transactions, secure the network, and hunt for yield. Hard-capped at 100 billion ASHIB . No minting function.
